response.sql: WITH telescope_obs AS (SELECT t.bandusagepct, o.observstation, o.lunarstage FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, lunarstage, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescope_obs WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation, lunarstage), phase_stats AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) as num_stations FROM station_avgs GROUP BY lunarstage), total_stations AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) as total FROM station_avgs) SELECT ps.lunarstage, ps.avg_bandwidth, ps.num_stations, CAST(ps.num_stations AS FLOAT) / ts.total FROM phase_stats ps CROSS JOIN total_stations ts ORDER BY ps.lunarstage
